summary: Living space is tidy but has minor tip-over, toxic plant, and ottoman trip hazards.

hazards.title: Toxic Snake Plant to Pets
hazards.detail: Sansevieria contains saponins toxic to cats and dogs if chewed.
fixSteps: Relocate the snake plant out of pet reach.
Replace with a pet-safe alternative like a spider plant.

hazards.title: Tall Fragile Decor Tip-Over
hazards.detail: Tall ceramic vases on low table can easily be knocked over by pets.
fixSteps: Secure the base with museum putty to prevent tipping.
Move breakable ceramics to an elevated, stable surface.

hazards.title: Floor Poufs In Walkway
hazards.detail: Low leather ottomans obstruct the path around the coffee table.
fixSteps: Tuck poufs under or alongside the coffee table when not in use.
Ensure at least 2 feet of clear walking space around furniture.

hazards.title: Arc Floor Lamp Tip-Over
hazards.detail: Overhanging arc lamp may become unstable or tip if bumped.
fixSteps: Confirm the base is properly weighted and placed behind the sofa.
Ensure clear head clearance to avoid bumping the shade.

products.name: Museum Putty
products.reason: Prevents tabletop vases and decor from tipping over.
